name: Saltbrine Reach Diary
summary: Harbour towns, pirate coves, and the long Saltbrine Trawler. The deep wakes Krakens and worse — but the lobster catch is the best in Aelgard.

tasks.description: Catch a shrimp at the Saltbrine coast.
Kill a pirate.
Buy from Fishmonger Mara's shop.
Enter the pirate cove.
Kill a rock crab.
Cook a sardine at the harbour range.
Collect a barnacle shell.
Talk to Harbourmaster Cole.
Catch 5 fish at any Saltbrine spot.
Kill a seagull.
Use the harbourmaster's ferry to visit Pirate Cove.
Find the hidden pirate stash on Pirate Cove beach (exploration).
Complete 1 easy clue step in the Saltbrine harbour.
Catch 5 trout at the Saltbrine river mouth.
Craft a wooden raft at the harbour carpenter's bench.

easy.reward: Saltbrine cape (easy) + emote: salute. Diary lamp (easy) granting 2,500 XP to any skill.
easy.perk_description: Saltbrine teleport (3/day); +5% catch rate at coast spots.

tasks.description: Complete the Pirate King quest.
Catch a lobster at the coast (fishing 40).
Complete a lap of the Saltbrine Harbour agility course.
Kill a sea snake without getting poisoned.
Cook a lobster without burning it.
Kill a pirate captain.
Catch a swordfish (fishing 50).
Complete the Trawler's Call quest.
Participate in a Saltbrine Trawler run.
Buy a harpoon from the fish shop.
Catch one of every Saltbrine fish in a single trip.
Complete 1 medium clue step in the Saltbrine harbour.
Cook 40 lobsters on the harbour range.
Navigate the Saltbrine smuggler's tunnels (exploration).
Use the tidal shortcut between harbour and pirate cove (agility 45).

medium.reward: Saltbrine cape (medium) + harbour bank teleport. Angler's hat (saltbrine-elite cloth tier, skilling-outfit piece +4% fishing XP at coast). Diary lamp (medium) granting 7,500 XP to any skill above level 40.
medium.perk_description: Harbour bank teleport; noted fish from coast spots; +10% pearl chance from Trawler; angler's hat (fishing XP outfit bonus).

tasks.description: Complete Whispers from the Depths quest.
Catch a shark (fishing 76).
Cook a shark without burning it.
Kill a dagannoth.
Complete a round of Barbarian Assault.
Defeat the Pirate Captain boss instance.
Catch a monkfish (fishing 62).
Craft an anglerfish from the Trawler.
Kill a lobstrosity.
Collect a Saltbrine pearl from a pirate captain.
Complete a Barbarian Assault wave 10 run.
Complete 3 hard clue steps at the Saltbrine cliffs.
Fish and cook 50 sharks in a single trip.
Craft an angler's outfit piece from Trawler pearls.
Discover the drowned lighthouse (deep exploration).

hard.reward: Saltbrine cape (hard) + Kraken arena shortcut. Diary lamp (hard) granting 15,000 XP to any skill above level 60.
hard.perk_description: Kraken arena shortcut; +10% pearl chance from Trawler; harpoon special attack regen +50%.

tasks.description: Defeat the Kraken of Saltbrine.
Catch a dark crab in the Wilds (fishing 85).
Complete Barbarian Assault with all roles.
Earn a Fighter torso from Barbarian Assault.
Complete every Saltbrine quest.
Catch an anglerfish (fishing 82).
Kill a sea troll with magic.
Complete an elite clue step in the harbour.
Reach 99 fishing.
Kill the Kraken 50 times.
Solo a full Trawler run keeping the boat afloat.
Complete 3 elite clue steps in the Saltbrine cliffs.
Cook 1000 sharks across career (cumulative).
Craft the full Angler's outfit set from Trawler rewards.
Discover the deepwater Kraken nursery (deep exploration).

elite.reward: Saltbrine cape (elite — pearl-trim recolour), unlimited Saltbrine teleport, captain's tricorn (cosmetic). Mariner's oath (stat-bonus reward): +50% fishing XP when casting at coast spots (Ardougne Elite analog). Chance at Tidewalker pet (1/5000 per Kraken kill after completion). Diary lamp (elite) granting 50,000 XP to any skill above level 75.
elite.perk_description: Unlimited Saltbrine teleport; double fish at coast spots; Kraken kill instant-bank loot; +50% fishing XP at coast spots (stat-bonus); Tidewalker pet eligibility.
